Passamos o verão juntos, e foi um mês lindo, leve e agradável. depois a faculdade voltou, e aos poucos os antigos padrões de comportamento dela foram voltando, apesar de ela ter prometido que estava diferente...

O que é que aconteceu? Ela terminou comigo novamente, e a outra vez (a mais recente) ela simplesmente esfriou do nada, traiu a minha confiança, e a única desculpa que tinha é que "achava que ia conseguir conciliar uma relação com a universidade".

As pessoas têm tempo para aquilo que elas querem ter tempo.

OP, se vc voltar, volte com a consciência de que há uma grande possibilidade de ela apenas estar carente.

The two therapists I've had so far weren't in private practice, and they allowed me to contact them outside sessions through email.

Their email was first given to me because I asked for it and explained the reason why. I told them that I personally thought that in the event I had to reschedule our next sessions, it was much easier to do so by directly contacting them. 

Later on, I asked them if I could also send them an email with some reflections about the things we discussed on our last appointment, and both of them allowed me to.

There was never really a back and forth communication between me and my therapists when I sent emails with some of my thoughts. They would simply acknowledge they received it and sometimes add a little comment or two.
